review_note: At line 1898 morphism of ringed spaces i homeomorphism onto closed set with SURJECTIVE O_X→i_*O_Z has finite-type i_*F iff F finite-type. Draft retains homeomorphism, surjectivity and both directions.
statement:
Let $i : (Z, \mathcal{O}_Z) \to (X, \mathcal{O}_X)$ be a morphism of ringed
spaces. Assume $i$ is a homeomorphism onto a closed subset of $X$ and
that $\mathcal{O}_X \to i_*\mathcal{O}_Z$ is surjective.
Let $\mathcal{F}$ be an $\mathcal{O}_Z$-module.
Then $i_*\mathcal{F}$ is of finite type if and only if
$\mathcal{F}$ is of finite type.

review_note: At line 1945 for closed-set homeomorphic ringed-space map with SURJECTIVE O_X→i_*O_Z and I kernel, i_*:Mod(O_Z)→Mod(O_X) is exact fully faithful with essential image precisely modules G annihilated by I. Draft retains all properties and necessary ideal-annihilation condition.
statement:
Let $i : (Z, \mathcal{O}_Z) \to (X, \mathcal{O}_X)$ be a morphism
of ringed spaces. Assume $i$ is a homeomorphism onto a closed subset of $X$
and $i^\sharp : \mathcal{O}_X \to i_*\mathcal{O}_Z$ is surjective.
Denote $\mathcal{I} \subset \mathcal{O}_X$ the kernel of $i^\sharp$.
The functor
$$
i_* :
\textit{Mod}(\mathcal{O}_Z)
\longrightarrow
\textit{Mod}(\mathcal{O}_X)
$$
is exact, fully faithful, with essential image those
$\mathcal{O}_X$-modules $\mathcal{G}$ such that $\mathcal{I}\mathcal{G} = 0$.

original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-i-star-equivalence}
Let $i : (Z, \mathcal{O}_Z) \to (X, \mathcal{O}_X)$ be a morphism
of ringed spaces. Assume $i$ is a homeomorphism onto a closed subset of $X$
and $i^\sharp : \mathcal{O}_X \to i_*\mathcal{O}_Z$ is surjective.
Denote $\mathcal{I} \subset \mathcal{O}_X$ the kernel of $i^\sharp$.
The functor
$$
i_* :
\textit{Mod}(\mathcal{O}_Z)
\longrightarrow
\textit{Mod}(\mathcal{O}_X)
$$
is exact, fully faithful, with essential image those
$\mathcal{O}_X$-modules $\mathcal{G}$ such that $\mathcal{I}\mathcal{G} = 0$.

review_note: At line 2038 for a closed inclusion i:Z→X of a ringed space, the functor of sections with SUPPORT IN Z H_Z:Mod(O_X)→Mod(O_X|_Z) is RIGHT adjoint to i_*. Draft spells out support-section definition and preserves adjunction orientation.
statement:
Let $(X, \mathcal{O}_X)$ be a ringed space. Let $i : Z \to X$ be the
inclusion of a closed subset. For each $\mathcal{O}_X$-module $\mathcal{F}$, let $\mathcal{H}_Z(\mathcal{F})$ be the $\mathcal{O}_X|_Z$-module on $Z$ obtained from the subsheaf of $\mathcal{F}$ whose sections on open $U\subseteq X$ have support in $U\cap Z$.
The functor
$\mathcal{H}_Z : \textit{Mod}(\mathcal{O}_X) \to
\textit{Mod}(\mathcal{O}_X|_Z)$
is right adjoint to
$i_* : \textit{Mod}(\mathcal{O}_X|_Z) \to \textit{Mod}(\mathcal{O}_X)$.

original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-adjoint-section-with-support}
Let $(X, \mathcal{O}_X)$ be a ringed space. Let $i : Z \to X$ be the
inclusion of a closed subset. The functor
$\mathcal{H}_Z : \textit{Mod}(\mathcal{O}_X) \to
\textit{Mod}(\mathcal{O}_X|_Z)$ of
Remark \ref{remark-sections-support-in-closed-modules}
